name: adventure
description: Go on an exciting adventure to explore new lands and discover valuable coins and items that will aid you on your journey.

name: battle
description: Engage in battles against fearsome monsters to earn coins, obtain valuable items, and gain experience points to level up.

name: bulkinfo
description: Retrieve information about all or filtered items and show their name, cost, and ID.

name: config
description: Access and customize server settings to adjust the turnipRPG experience to your likings.

name: crafting
description: Discover crafting recipes to create powerful items and tools that will enhance your abilities in the world of turnipRPG.

name: eat
description: Consume food and beverages to replenish your health, energy, and other vital attributes, keeping you prepared for challenges.

name: explore
description: Embark on journeys of open world exploration to uncover hidden secrets, uncovering new areas and unlocking rewards.

name: farm view
description: View and manage your farmland, monitoring the progress of crops and choosing what to grow next.

name: farm plant
description: Select a seed and plant them on your farm.

name: fish
description: Engage in the art of fishing to catch a variety of aquatic creatures, providing you with a source of food and other valuable items.

name: help
description: Access a comprehensive guide to all turnipRPG commands, empowering you to make the most of your adventure in the virtual world.

name: information
description: Access information on various topics to expand your knowledge and gain insights that will aid you in your turnipRPG adventures.

name: inventory
description: Display a comprehensive list of all the items currently stored in your inventory, helping you keep track of your belongings.

name: invite
description: Obtain a link that allows you to invite the turnipRPG bot to other Discord servers, enabling more users to join the fun.

name: item
description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific item, displaying things such as it's rarity, description, and uses for the item.

name: leaderboard
description: Check the rankings on the global or server specific leaderboards, comparing your performance in terms of coins or experience points.

name: menu
description: Open the comprehensive menu system, allowing you to access various game features, settings, and commands.

name: monster
description: Retrieve detailed information about different monsters in the turnipRPG world, learning about their strengths, weaknesses, and potential rewards.

name: play
description: Create a profile for yourself and begin your turnipRPG journey, immersing yourself in the exciting and dynamic virtual world.

name: preferences
description: Set and customize user preferences, tailoring your turnipRPG experience to your personal preferences and playstyle.

name: profile
description: View the profile of yourself or another user, gaining insights into achievements, progress, and character information.

name: quests
description: View and manage your quests, tracking your objectives, rewards, and progress as you complete various challenges.

name: sell
description: Sell unwanted items from your inventory to earn valuable coins.

name: shop
description: Explore each server's shop to view and purchase a variety of items and resources to enhance your gameplay.

name: vote
description: Show your support for turnipRPG by participating in community voting. Your votes help improve the bot and can contribute to its ongoing development.
